title: Khmer Rouge Genocide
description:
From 1975 to 1979, the **Khmer Rouge** regime led by Pol Pot ruled Cambodia with extreme brutality.

The regime sought to create an agrarian socialist society, forcibly evacuating cities and executing intellectuals, professionals, and minorities.

An estimated 1.7 to 2 million people died from execution, starvation, and disease - approximately 25% of Cambodia's population.
